title: Worn ring round 2
desc: W2 with light rays and smoke and a faint texture forming on the arm; W3 scrapped; W4 rise only while holding space.

takes.name: light rays
takes.facts: texture forms faintly up the arm 10-70; six thin rays fan from the ring from 40
takes.cam3p: Cam W2a light rays - third person
takes.camfp: Cam W2a light rays - first person

takes.name: smoke
takes.facts: texture forms faintly up the arm 10-70; cube smoke puffs rise from the ring from 40

takes.name: rays and smoke
takes.facts: texture forms faintly up the arm 10-70; rays and smoke from 40
takes.cam3p: Cam W2c rays and smoke - third person
takes.camfp: Cam W2c rays and smoke - first person

takes.name: rise, arm 120
takes.facts: only while holding space in flight; arm 120 deg ahead, head down 40, ground falling away
takes.cam3p: Cam W4a rise, arm 120 - third person
takes.camfp: Cam W4a rise, arm 120 - first person

takes.name: rise, arm 135
takes.facts: only while holding space in flight; arm 135 deg
takes.cam3p: Cam W4b rise, arm 135 - third person
takes.camfp: Cam W4b rise, arm 135 - first person

takes.name: rise, arm 150
takes.facts: only while holding space in flight; arm 150 deg, still not overhead
